data.body:
Investigation stocktake; keep open rather than claiming a speculative fix. Local repeated N=3000 samples on the same macOS host were 20.19-21.63s. cProfile attributed 13.69s to the 24 real git-add/git-commit pairs required by the locked durability contract, not to removable validation/materialization work. The test still asserts exactly 3,000 tickets, 3,000 comments, 6,000 events, 24 crash-safe commits, >=10x commit reduction, clean index, complete state, rollback, and resume.

Recent hosted evidence is below the 20s individual-test threshold: exact no-RAM control 31868300174 reported 18.61s on macOS; final full run 31873067707 reported 19.85s on macOS and 14.74s / 16.81s / 15.95s on Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13. Earlier organic control 31859036505 was 19.69s. Thus this node is not a consistent >20s hosted long pole in current runs, although local and historical outliers show variation.

The maintained-OSS-consensus RAM-disk storage lever was tested independently and falsified: every macOS treatment was slower, so filesystem placement cannot be used as evidence that these 24 required Git boundaries are safely avoidable. The separate source-checkout subprocess ticket panpsychic-clever-hawk also found no OSS consensus for replacing real Git semantics with a new library solely for metadata reads. No code was changed under this ticket, and no contractual assertion or commit boundary should be weakened.

Disposition: leave in_progress for a future matched hosted outlier profile or a fidelity-preserving implementation that keeps all 24 boundaries. Closure is not yet justified because the before/after implementation and full-matrix acceptance criteria have no implemented candidate; current evidence only narrows the problem and shows it is not the normal hosted critical path.
